summary: Jersey Central Power & Light Co., a FirstEnergy subsidiary, filed an 8-K on July 16, 2026, announcing an exchange offer for up to $350 million of its outstanding unregistered 4.600% Senior Notes due 2030 into registered notes of the same principal, coupon, and maturity. The exchange is a routine registration-rights fulfillment, not a tender for cash or a debt restructuring. Expiration is August 13, 2026. No price, premium, or board recommendation is involved. This is a pure registration-statement mechanics filing with no special-situations implications.
